stem.text: The diagram shows a large crane on a construction site lifting a cube-shaped load at a constant speed.

stem.alt: Crane with a horizontal jib and a vertical mast on a hatched ground line, with a cable hanging from the end of the jib supporting a cube-shaped load; labelled crane, cable and load.

stem.text: A model is made of the crane, its load and the cable supporting the load.
The material used for each part of the model is the same as that in the full-size crane, cable and load. The model is one tenth full-size in all linear dimensions.
What is the ratio $\dfrac{\text{stress in the cable on the full-size crane}}{\text{stress in the cable on the model crane}}$?
